'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Michael Richards DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Double D Invasion'''. Transcription notes: Line 9 written ''Cithlank (unread)''; Line 30 written ''Short Range Combat''; Line 34 written ''We haven't Accurate (lens)''; Line 37 written ''Rolling x2''; Line 46 written ''3PO-hi''; Line 57 written ''Niheo''. Lines shown in italics are as written on the sheet and are not linked because the card could not be identified for certain.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Invasion / In Complete Control|Invasion]]
* '''Username:''' misfit agent
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
